senses.gloss:
1. इष्टि, इस्, f. impulse, acceleration, hurry; invita-
tion, order, despatch.

2. इष्टि, इस्, f. seeking, endeavouring to obtain;
wish, request, desire; any desired object, a desired
rule, a desideratum (a term applied to Patañjali's ad-
ditions to Pāṇini's rules); (इस्), m., Ved. seeking,
going after, guarding.

3. इष्टि, इस्, f. sacrificing, sacrifice; oblation con-
sisting of butter, fruits, &c., opposed to the sacrifice
of an animal or of Soma.
—इष्टि-पच, अस्, or इष्टि-
मुष्, ट्, m. an Asura, a demon.
—इष्ट्य्-अयन, अम्,
n. a series of oblations, a sacrifice lasting a long time.

1. इष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (for 2. see next page), sought;
wished, desired; liked, beloved; agreeable; cherished;
worshipped, reverenced, respected; regarded as good,
approved; valid; (अस्), m. a lover, a husband; the
plant Ricinus Communis; (आ), f., N. of a plant;
(अम्), n. wish, desire; (अम्), ind. voluntarily.
—इष्-
ट-कर्मन्, अ, n. (in arithmetic) rule of supposition,
operation with an assumed number.
—इष्ट-काप-
थ, अस्, m. the root of the fragrant grass Andropo-
gon Muricatus.
—इष्ट-काम-दुह्, धुक्, f. ‘grant-
ing the wished-for desires,’ epithet of the cow of
plenty.
—इष्ट-गन्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, fragrant; (अस्),
m. any fragrant substance; (अम्), n. sand.
—इष्ट-
जन, अस्, m. a beloved person, man or woman; a
loved one.
—इष्ट-तम, अस्, आ, अम्, most desired,
best beloved, beloved, dearest.
—इष्ट-तर, अस्, आ,
अम्, more desired, more dear, dearer.
—इष्ट-तस्,
ind. according to one's wish or desire.
—इष्ट-ता, f.
or इष्ट-त्व, अम्, n. desirableness, the state of being
beloved or reverenced.
—इष्ट-देव, अस्, m. or
इष्ट-देवता, f. a chosen or tutelary deity, a
favourite god, one particularly worshipped.
—इष्ट-
यामन्, आ, आ, अ, Ved. going according to one's de-
sire.
—इष्ट-रश्मि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. having desired
or best reins or bridles.
—इष्ट-व्रत, अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. obeying one's wish; (Say.) that by which good
works succeed.
—इष्टा-कृत, अम्, n., Ved. wish and
deed, i. e. accomplishment of a wish (?); N. of a
certain sacrificial ceremony.
—इष्टा-पूर्त, अम्, n.,
Ved. wish and fulfilment, i. e. fulfilment of one's
wishes; any religious duty or pious act, as oblation,
sacrifice, penance, holy study, digging a well, plant-
ing a tree, &c.
—इष्टार्थ (˚ट-अर्˚), अस्, m. any-
thing desired or agreeable.
—इष्टार्थोद्युक्त (˚थ-
उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, zealously active, diligent for a
desired object.
—इष्टाश्व (˚ट-अश्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
Ved. having desired or best horses.

इष्ट 2. इष्ट, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. यज्; for 1. इष्ट
see last page), sacrificed, worshipped with sacrifices;
(अस्), m. sacrifice; (अम्), n. sacrificing; sacred rite,
sacrament.
—इष्ट-यजुस्, उस्, उस्, उस्, Ved. one to
whom sacrificial verses have been offered or addressed.
—इष्टा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of sacrifices.

इष्टका, f. a brick, especially one used in building
the altar of a sacrifice.
—इष्टका-गृह, अम्, n. a
brick house.
—इष्टका-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, built of bricks.
—इष्टका-न्यास, अस्, m. laying the foundation of a
house.
—इष्टका-राशि, इस्, m. a pile of bricks.

इष्टिका, f. a brick, especially one used in building
the sacrificial altar. See इष्टका above.
इष्टिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who has sacrificed.
इष्ट्वा, ind. having sacrificed or worshipped.

इष्टनि इष्टनि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. (if fr. rt. यज्),
to be worshipped; (if instead of नि-ष्टनि, fr. rt.
स्तन्), rustling, rushing.
